articles.summary: Every vehicle page headline is now the total vehicle price with your dealer fees inside it, the price the FTC's pricing FAQs ask dealers to advertise. Payments are worked out from that total, and a Price details section shows the same receipt as checkout.
articles.title: The FTC Wants the Whole Price Up Front. Your Vehicle Pages Have It.

articles.summary: Open a conversation in the Admin Portal and the vehicle cards, bookings, pre-qualification results and contact forms the buyer saw in web chat sit in the transcript. A message sent from a nudge is marked as sent automatically.
articles.title: See What the Buyer Saw

articles.summary: Open the chat widget preview in the Admin Portal while the widget is still off for your site, so your team can try the agent before visitors see it. You can also turn individual quick actions on or off for every domain.
articles.title: Try Your Chat Widget Before It Goes Live

articles.summary: Storefront search results and vehicle pages show their photos much sooner. Search results now appear about 60% faster on a fast connection, and nearly 80% faster on a slow one.
articles.title: Storefront Photos Load 60% Faster

articles.summary: On a phone, every Admin Portal list turns into cards and every drawer fills the screen. Reply to a lead, review an order or invite a preorder buyer from wherever you are, with nothing to install.
articles.title: The Admin Portal on Your Phone

articles.summary: Press Cmd+K (Ctrl+K on Windows) from any page in the Admin Portal to search orders, leads, conversations, inventory and preorders at once, plus every page and settings section. Results are ranked by relevance, and the records you opened last are one keystroke away.
articles.title: Find Anything From Anywhere in the Admin Portal

articles.summary: When a lead needs a person, the AI Sales Agent texts the rep who owns it. A reply of a few words answers a buyer's question or puts a hot lead in the rep's hands to call, so it is even easier to turn leads into buyers.
articles.title: Act on Leads in Seconds, From Your Phone
